_status: DRAFT - pending clinic review. Plain-language clause per scored marker, adapted from the descriptions the report already shows (markers_reference.MARKER_DESCRIPTIONS). Used only to add one sentence to a category's text: '<clause>, so this part of your <system> is (not yet) optimized.' A marker with no entry gets no added sentence. Never states why a result moved.

explanations.hs-CRP: hs-CRP measures low-grade inflammation throughout your body
explanations.Myeloperoxidase: Myeloperoxidase is an enzyme released when artery walls are inflamed
explanations.Lp-PLA2 Activity: Lp-PLA2 Activity tracks hidden inflammation in your arteries
explanations.ADMA: ADMA limits how well your blood vessels can relax
explanations.SDMA: SDMA is cleared by your kidneys and helps check how well they filter
explanations.Oxidized LDL: Oxidized LDL is LDL cholesterol that has been damaged and is more likely to build up in arteries
explanations.Fibrinogen: Fibrinogen is a clotting protein that rises with inflammation
explanations.Total Cholesterol: Total Cholesterol is all the cholesterol carried in your blood
explanations.HDL Cholesterol: HDL Cholesterol helps clear excess cholesterol from your arteries
explanations.Triglycerides: Triglycerides are fat carried in your blood, closely tied to diet and blood sugar
explanations.LDL Cholesterol: LDL Cholesterol is the cholesterol most associated with plaque in your arteries
explanations.Non-HDL Cholesterol: Non-HDL Cholesterol counts all the cholesterol carriers that can contribute to plaque
explanations.LDL-P (particle count): LDL-P counts the LDL particles carrying cholesterol through your arteries
explanations.HDL-P: HDL-P counts the HDL particles available to clear cholesterol
explanations.Apolipoprotein B: Apolipoprotein B counts the particles that can carry cholesterol into artery walls
explanations.Lipoprotein(a): Lipoprotein(a) is an inherited cholesterol particle linked to heart and blood vessel risk
explanations.Glucose (fasting): Fasting glucose is your blood sugar after an overnight fast
explanations.HbA1c: HbA1c reflects your average blood sugar over roughly the last three months
explanations.Estimated Average Glucose: Estimated Average Glucose expresses your HbA1c as an average blood sugar level
explanations.TMAO: TMAO is a compound made in your gut that is linked to heart and blood vessel risk
explanations.Insulin Resistance Score: Insulin Resistance Score shows how hard your body works to keep blood sugar in range
explanations.Fasting Insulin: Fasting Insulin is the insulin your body needs to manage blood sugar at rest
explanations.C-Peptide: C-Peptide shows how much insulin your body is producing
explanations.Cortisol, Total (AM): Cortisol is your main stress hormone, measured in the morning
explanations.DHEA-S: DHEA-S is a hormone building block made by your adrenal glands
explanations.Estradiol: Estradiol is your primary estrogen hormone
explanations.Testosterone, Total: Total Testosterone is all the testosterone circulating in your blood
explanations.LH: LH is a signal from your pituitary that tells your body to make sex hormones
explanations.FSH: FSH is a signal from your pituitary involved in making reproductive hormones
explanations.TSH: TSH is the signal your brain sends to your thyroid to set your metabolic pace
explanations.Free T4: Free T4 is the thyroid hormone available to your tissues
explanations.Total T4: Total T4 is all the main thyroid hormone in your blood
explanations.Free T3: Free T3 is the active thyroid hormone your cells use
explanations.Total T3: Total T3 is all of the active thyroid hormone in your blood
explanations.Thyroid Peroxidase Ab: Thyroid Peroxidase Ab is an antibody that can show your immune system targeting your thyroid
explanations.Thyroglobulin Ab: Thyroglobulin Ab is an antibody that can show your immune system targeting your thyroid
explanations.Vitamin D: Vitamin D supports your bones, immunity and mood
explanations.Vitamin B12: Vitamin B12 is a vitamin your nerves and red blood cells depend on
explanations.CoQ10: CoQ10 is a nutrient your cells use to produce energy
explanations.Folate: Folate is a B vitamin your body needs to build new cells
explanations.Omega-3 Index: Omega-3 Index is the share of omega-3 fats in your cell membranes
explanations.Ferritin: Ferritin is your body's stored iron
explanations.eGFR: eGFR estimates how well your kidneys filter your blood
explanations.Phosphorus: Phosphorus is a mineral that works with calcium in your bones and energy use
explanations.Magnesium: Magnesium is a mineral involved in your muscle, nerve and energy function
explanations.Uric Acid: Uric Acid is a waste product that can build up in your joints and blood vessels
explanations.Progesterone: Progesterone is a hormone that balances estrogen
explanations.Free Testosterone: Free Testosterone is the testosterone available for your tissues to use
explanations.Bioavailable Testosterone: Bioavailable Testosterone is the testosterone your body can readily use
explanations.SHBG: SHBG is a protein that binds sex hormones and controls how much is available
explanations.PSA Total: PSA is a prostate health screening marker
explanations.Creatinine: Creatinine is a muscle waste product used to check how well your kidneys work
explanations.Troponin T, HS: Troponin T is a sensitive marker of strain on your heart muscle
